name: Matillion ETL
description_en:
Matillion ETL is the warehouse-oriented integration product that runs in a customer cloud environment. Orchestration jobs load data and manage resources; transformation jobs manipulate data already in warehouse tables. Its visual canvas assembles configured components rather than removing the need to understand SQL and destination behavior.

The current company site separately presents Maia Team and Maia Foundation, formerly Data Productivity Cloud. This record remains about Matillion ETL and does not transfer every Maia agent, SaaS feature or price to that installed product.
description_zh:
Matillion ETL 是运行于客户云环境、面向仓库的集成产品。编排任务加载数据并管理资源，转换任务处理仓库表中已有数据。可视化画布组合配置组件，仍需理解 SQL 与目标行为。

当前公司网站另外展示 Maia Team 与 Maia Foundation，后者原名 Data Productivity Cloud。本文仍聚焦 Matillion ETL，不把每项 Maia 代理、SaaS 功能或价格转移到该安装产品。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate external loading/resource control from transformations of warehouse tables.
core_features.explanation_zh: 区分外部加载／资源控制与仓库表转换。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure timezones, missed-run handling and duplicate-job prevention.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置时区、错过运行处理及防止重复任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Retry a connected component with a bounded count and optional backoff.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以有限次数及可选退避重试所连接组件。

en: Load staged order data and transform warehouse tables.
Evaluate scheduled catch-up and bounded retry behavior.
zh: 加载暂存订单并转换仓库表。
评估调度补跑及有限重试行为。

sections.title_en: Load first, then transform in the selected platform
sections.title_zh: 先加载，再在所选平台转换
sections.en: Jobs use components that depend on the warehouse and product version. Orchestration can create resources and load external data; transformation can filter, cast, rank or aggregate existing tables. A proposed evaluation could load daily order files into staging, cast dates and aggregate net sales into a separate table. Keep a source file identifier and compare source/staging/final totals. A generic product connector list does not establish compatibility for every cloud/warehouse pair.
sections.zh: 任务组件依赖仓库和产品版本。编排可创建资源、加载外部数据；转换可过滤、转换类型、排名或聚合已有表。建议试验：将每日订单文件加载到暂存区，转换日期，在独立表中汇总净销售额；保留源文件标识，对照源、暂存及最终总数。通用连接器列表不能证明所有云与仓库组合均兼容。

sections.title_en: A running instance and missed-run policy matter
sections.title_zh: 运行中的实例与错过调度策略都重要
sections.en: Scheduled and queued jobs require the ETL instance to be running. After downtime, normal misfire handling can queue missed runs; Ignore misfires discards those runs instead. Prevent duplicate job avoids queuing another run while the same scheduled job/environment is active. These options solve different problems. Check timezones and daylight-saving behavior, then decide whether a delayed batch should catch up or be skipped. Disabling the project scheduler also halts documented API invocations, so an API trigger is not an independent escape from scheduling state.
sections.zh: 计划及排队任务要求 ETL 实例正在运行。停机后，常规错过调度处理可能补排运行；Ignore misfires 则丢弃这些运行。Prevent duplicate job 避免同一计划任务／环境仍活跃时再次入队；两者解决的问题不同。应检查时区及夏令时，再决定延迟批次是补跑还是跳过。禁用项目调度器也会使文档所述 API 调用暂停，因此 API 触发不独立于调度状态。

sections.title_en: Retry needs a sensible transaction boundary
sections.title_zh: 重试需有合理事务边界
sections.en: The Retry component stops on success or after its configured retries; the initial attempt is additional to that count. Delay strategies include immediate retry, fixed delay and backoff. Snowflake/Redshift documentation warns that retrying inside an unrolled-back transaction can fail again, and suggests retrying a nested orchestration with its own transaction logic. This does not make all external API/file operations transactional. Test a disposable failed load and inspect committed destination state before replaying.
sections.zh: Retry 组件在成功或达到配置重试次数后停止，初次运行不计入重试次数；延迟策略含立即、固定延迟及退避。Snowflake／Redshift 文档警告：在未回滚事务内重试可能再次失败，建议重试含自身事务逻辑的嵌套编排。这不能让所有外部 API／文件操作具备事务性。应以可丢弃失败加载测试，在重放前检查目标已提交状态。

sections.title_en: Customer-cloud installation comes with operational work
sections.title_zh: 客户云安装伴随运维责任
sections.en: The instance guide requires x86_64 and lists a 2vCPU/8GiB minimum for AWS/Azure. CPU, memory and networking affect performance; insufficient memory can fail the instance. This is a starting requirement, not measured production sizing. A pipeline owner must maintain the instance, source access, warehouse capacity and version compatibility. The visual editor is not a managed warehouse or a guarantee that source schema changes remain harmless.
sections.zh: 实例指南要求 x86_64，并列出 AWS／Azure 最低 2vCPU、8GiB。CPU、内存及网络影响性能，内存不足可使实例失败；这是入门要求，不是实测生产规格。流程负责人需维护实例、源访问、仓库容量及版本兼容。可视化编辑器不是托管仓库，也不能保证源结构变化总是无影响。

sections.title_en: Do not use the general SaaS price as an ETL quote
sections.title_zh: 不能把通用 SaaS 定价直接当 ETL 报价
sections.en: The ETL instance guide meters credits per vCPU-hour and excludes customer cloud VM costs. Associated Maia instances have five active users per 30-day subscription period, then the billing guide specifies 50 credits per additional user; orchestration API users count too. Marketplace $0.01 units represent aggregated charges, not a universal ETL price. ETL-only subscriptions require support contact. The general pricing page instead explains Data Productivity Cloud task hours and developer users. Confirm the exact ETL edition, instance, credit rate and warehouse/storage/network costs; no dependable all-in numeric starting price was established.
sections.zh: ETL 实例指南按 vCPU 小时计 credit，客户云 VM 成本另计。关联 Maia 的实例每 30 天订阅期含五个活跃用户，计费指南说明额外每用户 50 credit，编排 API 用户也计入。Marketplace 的 $0.01 单位用于结算汇总费用，不是统一 ETL 价格。仅订阅 ETL 需联系支持；通用定价页则解释 Data Productivity Cloud 任务小时及开发用户。应确认具体 ETL 版本、实例、credit 费率及仓库／存储／网络费用，本次未确认可靠全包数字起价。

sections.title_en: Evaluate ETL as an installed warehouse engineering tool
sections.title_zh: 把 ETL 作为安装式仓库工程工具评估
sections.en: Matillion ETL merits evaluation for teams owning a supported cloud warehouse and seeking reusable visual loading/transformation jobs. It is less suited to someone expecting one subscription to include a warehouse, all infrastructure management and every current Maia agent. Source-code redistribution rights, exact license terms, high-availability recovery and measured throughput remain unverified here. No trial instance, schedule or SQL workload was executed.
sections.zh: 当团队已有受支持云仓库，希望使用可复用可视化加载／转换任务时，可评估 Matillion ETL。若期待一个订阅同时涵盖仓库、全部基础设施运维及所有当前 Maia 代理，适用性较弱。本次未确认源码再分发权利、具体许可、高可用恢复及实测吞吐，也未运行试用实例、调度或 SQL 负载。
